pick.headline: Moscow announces Sakharov may return from exile
pick.summary: On December 19, 1986, the Soviet government announced that Andrey Sakharov could return to Moscow from internal exile in Gorkiy, where he had been watched by the KGB since 1980.
pick.significance: Sakharov's release was the most visible sign that Gorbachev's reforms extended to the treatment of dissidents.
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of December 19, 1986, listed "Sakharov, Bonner Allowed To Return to Moscow" among its national affairs items; much of the contents page is garbled.
